How_Calculated: Pallets produced in the report shift day (line take-away / work-order receipts in PrIME) divided by the hours elapsed since the shift day started.
Numbers: {[Prod Pallets Day]|#,##0} plt produced / {[Elapsed Hours]|0.0} h elapsed
Prediction_Method: End-of-day projection = pallets so far + run rate of the last RUN_RATE_HOURS completed hours x hours left; forecast plt/h = projection / 24 h.
Diagnosis: Below target: a line stopped or runs slow, take-away pallets are not scanned, or production is not received in PrIME (compare SAP on 'Production SAP vs PrIME').

How_Calculated: Pallets produced so far divided by the day plan pro-rated to the hours elapsed (RAMP_DAY_PLAN x elapsed / 24).
Numbers: {[Prod Pallets Day]|#,##0} plt vs pro-rated plan {[Prod Ramp Plan Day] * [Elapsed Hours] / 24|#,##0} plt (day plan {[Prod Ramp Plan Day]|#,##0} plt); recovery needs {[Prod Required Rate]|#,##0} plt/h
Prediction_Method: Projected end-of-day pallets (pallets so far + recent run rate x hours left) / day plan.
Diagnosis: Behind plan: check line status and the rate needed to recover; a line down or not reporting in PrIME is the usual cause.

How_Calculated: Pallets of the current shift divided by the PPH target x hours elapsed in that shift.
Numbers: {[Prod Pallets Day]|#,##0} plt in the day so far / {[Elapsed Hours]|0.0} h
Diagnosis: Shift behind: see the hour-by-hour report for the hour the output dropped.

How_Calculated: Production lines whose last completed hour is below LINE_ALERT_PCT of their own LOOKBACK-day baseline for the same hour.
Numbers: {[KPI Lines In Alert]|0} line(s) below their baseline
Diagnosis: Walk the lines in alert with the production supervisor; check the produced column of the Daily & Hourly Report.

How_Calculated: Number of consecutive completed hours with falling production output.
Numbers: {[KPI Trend Hours]|0} h in a row declining
Diagnosis: A falling trend before a stop: check line material supply, take-away and staffing.

How_Calculated: Average check-in -> dispatch minutes of the inbound trucks dispatched in the report shift day (truck counted on the day it left).
Numbers: {[Inbound Trucks]|0} trucks, average {[KPI TTAT In]|0} min, worst {[KPI TTAT In Max]|0} min, average unloading (GR) {[KPI GR Time]|0} min
Prediction_Method: Linear trend of the daily average inbound TTAT over the last FORECAST_DAYS days, read at the report day.
Diagnosis: High TTAT: trucks wait for a door / crew (amber 'wait' segment on Trucks & TTAT), unloading is slow, or close / dispatch is not booked in WMS.

How_Calculated: Longest check-in -> dispatch minutes of one inbound truck dispatched in the report shift day.
Numbers: worst truck {[KPI TTAT In Max]|0} min of {[Inbound Trucks]|0} trucks (average {[KPI TTAT In]|0} min)
Diagnosis: One truck far above the average: look it up on Trucks & TTAT (longest bar) - waiting overnight, waiting for a door or not dispatched in WMS.

How_Calculated: Average unloading / goods-receipt minutes of the inbound trucks dispatched in the report shift day.
Numbers: {[Inbound Trucks]|0} trucks, average GR {[KPI GR Time]|0} min
Diagnosis: Slow receiving: labour at the dock, scanning problems or unplanned receipts.

How_Calculated: Average check-in -> close minutes of the outbound trucks closed in the report shift day.
Numbers: {[Outbound Trucks]|0} trucks, average {[KPI TTAT Out]|0} min
Prediction_Method: Linear trend of the daily average outbound TTAT over the last FORECAST_DAYS days, read at the report day.
Diagnosis: High TTAT: picking not finished when the truck arrives (see Process Mining: picked & staged -> loaded), loading slow, or close not booked.

How_Calculated: Average start -> end of loading minutes of the outbound trucks closed in the report shift day.
Numbers: {[Outbound Loads]|0} loads, average load {[KPI Out Load Time]|0} min
Diagnosis: Slow loading: pallets not staged in time, loading crew / equipment, or load closed late in WMS.

How_Calculated: Outbound pallets allocated from Level A divided by all outbound pallets allocated in the day.
Numbers: {[Out Alloc LevelA]|#,##0} plt from Level A of {[Out Alloc LevelA] + [Out Alloc Other]|#,##0} plt allocated
Diagnosis: Off target: allocation rules or Level A stock do not match the demand (Level A empty / full).

How_Calculated: Occupied storage locations divided by all storage locations (locmst snapshot at the last refresh).
Numbers: {[Loc Occupied]|#,##0} occupied of {[Loc Locations]|#,##0} locations, {[Loc Locations] - [Loc Occupied]|#,##0} free
Prediction_Method: Occupied now + PRED_HORIZON_H hours x the current net pallet flow (in minus out per hour), 1 pallet ~ 1 location.
Diagnosis: High: stock grows (inbound > outbound) or old / blocked stock holds space - see the Inventory page (age bands, status).

How_Calculated: Occupied Level A locations divided by all Level A locations (same locmst snapshot).
Numbers: {[LevelA Locations]|#,##0} Level A locations, {[LevelA Idle Locations]|#,##0} held by pallets without an active shipment
Prediction_Method: Occupied now + PRED_HORIZON_H hours x the current net Level A flow.
Diagnosis: Level A full of idle stock blocks replenishment - release / relocate idle pallets.

How_Calculated: Free Level A pallet spots for short pallets (location height <= TALL_HEIGHT_CM).
Numbers: {[KPI Free Short]|#,##0} short spots free
Diagnosis: Too few free spots: production pallets cannot be put away - relocate idle Level A stock.

How_Calculated: Free Level A pallet spots for tall pallets (location height > TALL_HEIGHT_CM).
Numbers: {[KPI Free Tall]|#,##0} tall spots free
Diagnosis: Too few free spots: production pallets cannot be put away - relocate idle Level A stock.

How_Calculated: Pallets waiting in the hand-off inbound lanes (finished goods and packing material).
Numbers: {[KPI HOFF In]|#,##0} pallets in HOFF IN
Diagnosis: Queue growing: put-away from the hand-off lane is behind - check put-away labour and free storage.

How_Calculated: Pallets waiting in the line take-away lanes for put-away.
Numbers: {[KPI LTA Queue]|#,##0} pallets in the LTA lanes
Diagnosis: Take-away behind production: forklift capacity or no free Level A spots.

How_Calculated: Inbound vs outbound pallet flow of the report day: |pallets in (produced / received) - pallets out (allocated outbound)| divided by pallets in.
Numbers: in {[Prod Pallets Day]|#,##0} plt vs out {[Out Alloc LevelA] + [Out Alloc Other]|#,##0} plt -> difference {ABS([Prod Pallets Day] - [Out Alloc LevelA] - [Out Alloc Other])|#,##0} plt
Diagnosis: In > out: stock builds up in the warehouse (space risk, see Location utilisation). Out > in: shipping from stock while production is behind.

How_Calculated: Pallets stored into Level A divided by all pallets stored in the day.
Numbers: {[LevelA In Day]|#,##0} plt into Level A of {[LevelA In Day] + [LevelA Other Day]|#,##0} plt stored
Diagnosis: Off target: put-away rules send pallets to the wrong zone or Level A is full.

How_Calculated: Level A locations holding pallets without an active shipment divided by all Level A locations.
Numbers: {[LevelA Idle Locations]|#,##0} idle of {[LevelA Locations]|#,##0} Level A locations
Diagnosis: Idle stock in the fast-pick zone: relocate to bulk storage to free Level A.

How_Calculated: Pallets moved (distinct LPN per user and hour) divided by the active RF user-hours of the report day.
Numbers: {[User Pallets Moved]|#,##0} plt moved / {[User Active Hours]|#,##0} user-hours ({[KPI Active Users]|0} users)
Prediction_Method: No forecast (trend average shown on User Productivity).
Diagnosis: Low: users waiting for work, travel / equipment problems, or system users counted (check USR_EXCLUDE) - see People.

How_Calculated: RF users with at least one pallet move in the report day.
Numbers: {[KPI Active Users]|0} users active
Diagnosis: Fewer users than planned: staffing or users not logged in on RF.

How_Calculated: Minutes between the replica database clock and the newest WMS transaction (dlytrn) at the last refresh.
Numbers: {[KPI Data Lag Min]|#,##0} min behind (newest transaction {[Data Last Txn]|dd-mmm hh:nn})
Diagnosis: Large lag with a quiet site is normal; with an active site the replication (HVR) is behind - check the data replica latency.

How_Calculated: Hours since the model was last refreshed.
Numbers: {[KPI Refresh Age h]|0.0} h since the last refresh
Diagnosis: Refresh not running: check the scheduled task / Service refresh and the credentials of the replica.

How_Calculated: Data-health checks failing (feeds empty, stale or out of range) - see Config & Health.
Numbers: {[KPI Health Fails]|0} of {[Health Checks Run]|0} checks failing
Diagnosis: Fix the failing feed first - the KPIs that depend on it are not reliable.

How_Calculated: Pallets moved by RF users in the latest complete hour divided by the average of the same hour on the last look-back days (1.00 = as usual).
Numbers: latest hour vs its usual level
Diagnosis: Below the usual level: fewer users active or a process stopped in that hour - see the Daily & Hourly Report.

How_Calculated: Produced pallets recorded in PrIME divided by the finished-goods pallets SAP received from production in the same days.
Numbers: PrIME pallets / SAP pallets
Diagnosis: Low coverage: production is booked in SAP but not received in the WMS - check the line-to-WMS integration.
